intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both teach {{course}} in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. This page compares recorded fees, placements and ranks from our database, and is honest about what is missing or out of date in {{year}}.

Sagar Institute of Science & Technology vs Technocrats Institute of Technology is a local Bhopal comparison. Neither side has a 2020 or later flagship placement record on this page, so fees, exams and older ranks have to do more of the work.

sections.heading: Sagar Institute of Science & Technology vs Technocrats Institute of Technology for B.Tech: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: There is no clean winner on recent placements, because our latest SISTec record is from 2019 and our latest TIT record is from 2018. Those years are too old to treat as current outcomes.
TIT has an older NIRF Engineering rank of 251 from 2021 in our records. SISTec has no NIRF Engineering rank here. Use current official reports before you decide on either campus.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: Our records list a year-wise total of ₹76,000 for SISTec B.Tech programmes on this page. Treat this as a recorded year fee, not a confirmed four-year total, until you check the institute's current fee notice.

For TIT our records show a year-wise total of ₹86,400. Both figures sit well above the ₹10,000 professional fee floor, so they are usable as recorded year fees, but they may not match the latest Affidavit or AFRC circular.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: SISTec's latest recorded row here is from 2019, with a highest package of ₹22 lakh and no usable average in that record. That is older than 2020, so this page does not treat it as a current flagship placement.
TIT's latest recorded row is from 2018, with an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹24 lakh. Do not compare a 2018 figure with a 2019 figure as if they described the same market.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Our records list JEE Main for SISTec and PET Madhya Pradesh for TIT. In practice, Bhopal engineering seats are also filled through the state counselling that uses JEE Main or the state test, depending on the year.
Confirm the current DTE Madhya Pradesh counselling brochure and each college's admission page before you apply. Eligibility wording can change by cycle.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both colleges are in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, so the move is not about leaving the city. Visit both campuses if commute, hostel and lab facilities will decide the choice for you.
A same-city comparison still needs current placement and fee notices, because the records on this page are thin on recent outcomes.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If recorded year fees are your first filter, SISTec's ₹76,000 is lower than TIT's ₹86,400 in our database. That is not a final decision by itself.
If you want any NIRF Engineering mention, only TIT has one here, and it is from 2021 at rank 251. Ask both colleges for their latest official placement report before you choose.
Do not treat the pre-2020 packages on this page as a forecast for 2026 graduates.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, SISTec or Technocrats Institute of Technology, for B.Tech?
faqs.answer: This page cannot name a placement winner, because the latest records are from 2019 for SISTec and 2018 for TIT. TIT has an older 2021 NIRF Engineering rank of 251. SISTec has a lower recorded year fee. Check current official reports before you decide.

faqs.question: What are the recorded B.Tech fees for SISTec vs TIT?
faqs.answer: Our records list ₹76,000 a year for SISTec and ₹86,400 a year for TIT. These are recorded year figures, not confirmed four-year totals. Confirm the current official fee notice of each institute.

faqs.question: Do SISTec and TIT have recent placement figures on this page?
faqs.answer: No usable 2020 or later flagship placement is on this page. SISTec's latest recorded row is 2019, with a highest package of ₹22 lakh. TIT's latest is 2018, with an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹24 lakh.

faqs.question: Which exams do SISTec and TIT accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list JEE Main for SISTec and PET Madhya Pradesh for TIT. Confirm the current Madhya Pradesh counselling rules, which may use JEE Main or the state test depending on the year.

faqs.question: Are SISTec and TIT in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. The comparison is about fees, exams and the limited rank data we hold, not a change of city.
